mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, client_message_id, message_type, content) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{messageType}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, send_time FROM message WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, send_time FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND client_message_id = #{clientMessageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.client_message_id, m.message_type, m.content, m.send_time FROM conversation c INNER JOIN message m ON m.conversation_id = c.id WHERE m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND ( (c.user_low_id = #{userId} AND m.id > c.user_low_last_sync_message_id) OR (c.user_high_id = #{userId} AND m.id > c.user_high_last_sync_message_id) ) ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
